_description: Upper-bound RANK CLAIMS from the literature without accompanying factor matrices. See GenerateCitedBounds.java for sources.

_schema.field: R | C | F2 | all — claim applies in this field-class
_schema.commutative: true if the bound only holds under commuting scalars (not useful for recursive matmul); false otherwise
_schema.rank: upper bound on the bilinear rank
_schema.algorithm: the technique/family that achieves this rank in the source
_schema.scheme_provided: whether the source provides explicit factor matrices (false = rank claim only)
_schema.source_paper_url: OPTIONAL — the publication the rank claim comes from
_schema.source_scheme_url: OPTIONAL — the scheme's file in the source author's own repo, too large to copy here; cite-don't-copy (e.g. Perminov's repo)
